scan_cameraDeniedBody.en: Scanning is unavailable. Turn it back on in Settings → LOOP → Camera.
scan_cameraDeniedBody.zh: 扫码功能不可用；可在 系统设置 → LOOP → 相机 中重新开启。

scan_cameraErrorReason.en: The camera didn't open. Retry, or use Photos below.
scan_cameraErrorReason.zh: 相机没有打开。可以重试，或改用下方的「相册」。

scan_cameraUnsupported.en: This device has no available camera
scan_cameraUnsupported.zh: 这台设备没有可用的相机

scan_cameraUnsupportedDetail.en: Use Photos below to read a QR code from an image.
scan_cameraUnsupportedDetail.zh: 可以改用下方的「相册」识别二维码图片。

scan_hint.en: Point at a LOOP profile card, invite poster, community QR code or wallet address QR code.
scan_hint.zh: 对准 LOOP 名片、邀请海报、社区二维码或钱包地址二维码。

scan_imageNoCode.en: No QR code found in this image
scan_imageNoCode.zh: 这张图片里没有识别到二维码

scan_imageNoPhotoAccess.en: No photo access. Allow LOOP to access Photos in Settings, then try again
scan_imageNoPhotoAccess.zh: 没有相册权限，去系统设置里允许 LOOP 访问照片后再试

scan_imageUnreadable.en: Couldn't read the image. Try another one
scan_imageUnreadable.zh: 图片没有读出来，请换一张再试

scan_unavailableDetail.en: This build doesn't include camera scanning; this page won't open the camera.
scan_unavailableDetail.zh: 这个版本没有装配相机扫码，本页不会打开相机。

scan_unknownBody.en: LOOP won't open this content; it's only shown below.
scan_unknownBody.zh: LOOP 不会打开这段内容，只把它显示在下面。
